parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the applications that the EIAM account can access. You can query a maximum of 100 application IDs at a time.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: QueryMode
parameters.description:
The query mode. Default value: **OnlyDirect**. Valid values:

*   OnlyDirect: Only the direct permissions are queried. Direct permissions are the permissions that are directly granted to the account.
*   IncludeInherit: Both the permissions that are directly granted to the account and the inherited permissions are queried. Inherited permissions are the permissions that an account inherits from the parent organization or the group to which the account belongs.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: The ID of the EIAM account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam list-applications-for-user --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --application-ids app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --query-mode OnlyDirect --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam ListApplicationsForUser --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PageNumber 1 --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --QueryMode OnlyDirect --ApplicationIds.1 app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
